status.description: HLTH-2. The Worker's own summary. HLTH-3 forbids `healthy` while any check it reports is not passing.

detail.description: HLTH-2. Short, human-readable, addressed to whoever is looking. Not addressed to a program: nothing in this protocol parses it.

additionalProperties.title: Health check
additionalProperties.description: HLTH-2. One dependency or invariant a Worker reports on, under its own name.

checks.description: HLTH-2. Keyed by check name. Whether check names are shared across Workers is open, which is why the key carries no pattern; if they come to be shared they become a name that crosses between Workers and NAME-7 reaches them.

title: Health
description: HLTH-2. What a Worker answers at the address its `health` entry declares.
